name: Do chemical drain cleaners work on toilet clogs?

mainEntity.name: Do chemical drain cleaners work on toilet clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: While chemical drain cleaners are available, they are generally not recommended for toilet clogs. These harsh chemicals can damage pipes, especially older ones, and may not fully clear the blockage, potentially making the problem worse. They can also pose a safety risk due to fumes and skin contact. A professional plumber uses safer and more effective methods like snaking.
acceptedAnswer.description: Chemical drain cleaners are not recommended for toilet clogs as they can damage pipes and aren't always effective or safe.
